codeReview.summary: Both blocking issues from the prior ws-endpoint-rewiring review are addressed. (1) streaming.py now emits only status, text, reasoning, tool_call, tool_result, and done — all legacy emission paths (trajectory_step, hitl_request, assistant_token, reasoning_step, final, cancelled as emitted kinds) have been removed. The StreamEventKind Literal retains the old names for backward-compat consumers but the runtime no longer produces them. (2) factory.py no longer references RLMReActChatAgent; it constructs and returns AgentRuntime (which internally wraps FleetAgent). The test test_build_chat_agent_returns_agent_runtime is present and explicitly checks isinstance(agent, AgentRuntime). Three non-blocking issues are noted below.

issues.description: _activate_live_event_queue still filters kind 'error' alongside legacy 'final'/'cancelled' in the live event callback: `if event.kind in {"final", "cancelled", "error"}: return`. The 'error' kind is now a canonical simplified kind (in the required set). Child/nested runtime callbacks that produce error StreamEvents will be silently dropped instead of propagated to the outer stream. The filter was presumably carried over from before the kind simplification. Filtering 'final' and 'cancelled' is still reasonable (they are legacy termination kinds that the outer stream handles itself), but 'error' should likely be propagated.

build_chat_agent accepts ~20 keyword arguments (docs_path, deep_react_max_iters, enable_adaptive_iters, rlm_max_iterations, rlm_max_llm_calls, max_depth, timeout, secret_name, volume_name, runtime, verbose, interpreter_async_execute, delete_session_on_shutdown, sandbox_spec, sub_lm, guardrail_mode, max_output_chars, min_substantive_chars, delegate_lm, delegate_max_calls_per_turn, delegate_result_truncation_chars) but the implementation only threads through max_iters, history_max_turns, and extra_tools. All other parameters are silently ignored. Callers such as the bootstrap that pass sandbox_spec or guardrail_mode will get no-op behavior without error. This is significant tech debt that should be tracked.

FleetAgent is imported with `# noqa: F401` but is neither used directly in factory.py nor listed in __all__. AgentRuntime constructs FleetAgent internally, so this import is dead code. It should either be added to __all__ as an explicit re-export contract, or removed.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The 'warning' and 'error' kinds appear in StreamEventKind and TurnState.apply() as canonical simplified kinds, but no code in streaming.py or chat.py currently emits them directly. Guardrail warnings are embedded in the 'done' payload rather than emitted as separate 'warning' StreamEvents. If 'warning' is intended to be a live emitted kind, the emission path is missing. AGENTS.md and the validation contract should clarify whether these are reserved for future use or actively required.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: grep for kind='warning' in src/ returns zero results. Guardrail warnings appear in build_final_stream_event payload under 'guardrail_warnings' key rather than as emitted warning-kind events.

sharedStateObservations.observation: factory.py's build_chat_agent signature still carries the full legacy parameter set (sandbox_spec, runtime, volume_name, secret_name, etc.) even though AgentRuntime no longer accepts these. Callers in bootstrap/CLI that pass these parameters will silently get a wrong configuration. AGENTS.md should document that factory.py is now a thin wrapper and the full parameter set is not wired through.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/fleet_rlm/runtime/factory.py lines 23-67: 20+ parameters declared. AgentRuntime.__init__ (runtime/agent/runtime.py:573-598) only accepts interpreter, max_iters, history_max_turns, extra_tools.

summary: PASS. Both blocking issues from ws-endpoint-rewiring are resolved. VAL-WS-002: streaming.py now emits only the simplified canonical kinds (status, text, reasoning, tool_call, tool_result, done); all legacy emission paths are removed, verified by grep and test coverage. VAL-FACTORY-002: factory.py imports and constructs AgentRuntime from runtime/agent/runtime.py (no RLMReActChatAgent), and a new test_build_chat_agent_returns_agent_runtime assertion validates this. Three non-blocking issues remain: (1) 'error' kind is inadvertently filtered in the live event queue callback alongside legacy 'final'/'cancelled', (2) ~20 factory parameters are silently ignored since AgentRuntime only accepts 4 of them, (3) an unused FleetAgent import in factory.py is suppressed with noqa.
